name: camayoc_planned_actions
description: Exact-ID native planned Action reader, including deferred/blocked. Current board owns status/owner/dates; no legacy fallback. Candidate IDs come from bounded semantic retrieval or an actual creation event, never full-board enumeration. Up to101 raw rows is an overflow sentinel, not permission to return partial data.
